next_move.instructions: Which next tutoring move best fits what the learner has demonstrated on the current math task? Read the sequence of student work, tutor help, and described screen actions. Give greatest weight to the current task and the most recent substantive student contribution, using earlier turns to interpret it. A correct answer supplied by the tutor, or a student saying yes, does not by itself demonstrate understanding. An earlier error does not require more help after the learner has independently corrected and explained it.
